items.title: 💭 Kinopio
items.content_html:
Here’s my thought on Kinopio

kinopio is a pretty sweet map-mapping type of application. It’s localfirst, you can run it for free with state kept locally and that’s pretty dope. Heard about it on ep 9 of the localfirst.fm podcast. Very impressive app

Note

This is one of [[ my-thoughts ]]. I picked this up from Waylon Walker(https://thoughts.waylonwalker.com). It’s a short note that I make about someone else’s content online. Learn more about the process Thoughts
